item.description:
Welcome to the Watch Face Design Challenge — a premier design initiative powered by Hack2skill. Design Time Your Way

The Titan Watch Face Design Challenge 2026 invites you to create an original, innovative and user-friendly smartwatch face.

Bring your creativity to the wrist and explore new ways to make time look and feel better.

More than a design competition, the Watch Face Design Challenge is an opportunity to shape the future of everyday human-computer interaction. Collaborate with fellow innovators, showcase your user experience (UX) and visual design expertise, and build impactful watch face concepts that redefine how people connect with technology right on their wrists.
